blurb: Numerous and expendable. Wins by drowning objectives in bodies.
lore: The ash wastes make converts faster than any preacher. These are the people the hive spat out — tunnel scavengers, failed indentures, the second and third generations of families that were never registered — and somebody down there has finally given them a banner to die under. They own almost nothing and are unafraid of losing it, which makes them more dangerous than their equipment suggests.

source.notes: Fictional demo team. Not transcribed from any published game.

operatives.name: Cult Demagogue
operatives.lore: He was a foreman once, or claims he was, and the voice carries either way. What he promises is not salvation but a turn at the front of the queue, and in the ash that is enough.

operatives.name: Cult Gunner
operatives.lore: The mob's one real weapon, carried by whoever was holding it when the last man went down. He fires it in long, unaimed bursts because nobody ever taught him otherwise.

operatives.name: Cultist
operatives.lore: Rags, a stolen blade, and a conviction that outlasts both. He goes where the crowd goes and stands on the ground he is pointed at until somebody removes him from it.

strategicPloys.name: ENDLESS NUMBERS
strategicPloys.description: You can ignore the effects of being injured for friendly ASH LEGION operatives until the end of the turning point.

strategicPloys.name: FANATIC SURGE
strategicPloys.description: Each friendly ASH LEGION operative can perform a free Dash action during its activation this turning point. You cannot use this ploy during the first turning point.

firefightPloys.name: FRENZIED RUSH
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy during a friendly ASH LEGION operative's activation. Until the end of that activation, add 1 to its APL stat.

firefightPloys.name: PRESS OF BODIES
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts damage on a friendly ASH LEGION operative. Subtract 2 from that inflicted damage.
